title: IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow an authenticated attacker to send unauthorized requests from the…
description: IBM API Connect versions 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows an authenticated attacker to send unauthorized requests from the system. This vulnerability could enable attackers to enumerate internal network resources or facilitate further attacks.
